Fix `packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. vitest: getArrowheadPoints() > scales sideways half-width by arrowheadSize while keeping head angle unchanged on a long straight segment -- AssertionError: expected 7.5 to be close to 3.75 (bounds.test.ts:428, scaledHalfWidth vs baseHalfWidth * scale). Also eslint --max-warnings=0: 442:44 warning 'bottomX' is assigned a value but never used (@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars). Cause of the assertion: API.createElement in packages/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api.ts does NOT forward arrowheadSize to newArrowElement (its arrow branch passes only ...base, width, height, type, points, elbowed), so an arrow created with { arrowheadSize } comes back at the default size. That helper is outside the write contract and must not be changed. Fix in the test only: after API.createElement(...), set the size on the created element, e.g. `const arrow = arrowheadSize !== undefined ? { ...created, arrowheadSize } : created;`, then generate the shape with ShapeCache.generateElementShape(arrow, null) from that object. Remove every unused destructured variable. Keep the existing tests unchanged; keep strokeWidth 2 in the half-width test (a circle's diameter is size + strokeWidth - 2).
